comments.body: Closing in favor of #1113, which moves every model in `examples/` to the newest in its series. That PR updates both lines here to `claude-sonnet-5-5`: `agents_test.py` (where it also fixes the "GPT-4o mini" label) and `use_cua_desktop.py`. It also updates the retired `claude-sonnet-4-20250514` in `cua_desktop/config.yaml`. Thanks for flagging the retired models.
